name: Hermann Lang
features: fair skin, sandy blond hair, blue eyes, open honest face, strong cheekbones, athletic build, modest cheerful expression
bio: Lang joined Mercedes-Benz as a riding mechanic and worked his way into the works team — the only one of the Silver Arrows drivers who came from the shop floor. He owned the AVUS and Tripoli high-speed races, and won the 1939 European Championship in the W154 in the last season before the war.
